The teacher demonstrates the turn in the first sequence.

what_works: The teacher breaks down each sequence into manageable parts.
The teacher uses consistent counting throughout the lesson.
what_hinders: The video lacks verbal explanations of the footwork technique.
The teacher does not provide tips for posture or arm movements.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands in front of a plain wall and introduces the sequence.
The teacher performs the balseado step, shifting weight from one foot to the other.
The teacher performs a turn, moving his feet in a circular motion.
The teacher repeats the balseado step, demonstrating the rhythm.
The teacher performs the balseado step with a turn.
The teacher performs two planta steps with his left foot.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a structured approach, breaking down each sequence into smaller, repeatable parts and practicing them with consistent counting.
